svg.title: SeekRemoteJobs: AI-Powered Remote Job Aggregation
svg.desc: Live full-stack platform aggregating 40+ tech career pages with AI resume tools. React, Vite, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Puppeteer, Gemini, Groq, Docker.

g.text: Aggregates postings from 40+ top tech career pages into one searchable interface, with AI
resume parsing, tailoring, ATS scoring, cover letters and job matching.
